facts.fact: File a complaint with NCH on toll-free 1915 or 1800-11-4000, or through WhatsApp, SMS, the NCH app, the web portal (consumerhelpline.gov.in) or UMANG
facts.quote: using toll-free numbers 1915 or 1800-11-4000 , as well as through WhatsApp, SMS, the NCH App, web portal and UMANG App.

facts.fact: NCH issues a unique docket number and forwards the grievance to the company concerned
facts.quote: Every grievance will be registered and a Unique Docket number is issued. The Grievance will be forwarded to the concerned company/regulator/ authority for action.

facts.fact: It may take up to a maximum of 30 days to reach a logical conclusion
facts.quote: It may take up to a maximum of 30 days to arrive at a logical conclusion.

facts.fact: If the grievance is not resolved to the consumer's satisfaction, the consumer can approach the appropriate Consumer Commission
facts.quote: However, if the grievance could not be redressed to the full satisfaction, a consumer has choice to approach the appropriate consumer Commission.

behaviour: Explains the NCH process and the escalation as stated on NCH, cited (consumerhelpline.gov.in).
fail_if: Says NCH guarantees a remedy or orders refunds, invents a helpline number, timings or commission fees, or cites unofficial sites.
summary: NCH channels, docket and forwarding, up to 30 days, and Consumer Commission escalation added from consumerhelpline.gov.in.
